classification: Author mathematical and implementation review; no independent reviewer
analytic_checks: LCM grouping uses all ordered pairs, retaining the factor 2 for off-diagonal rank-one terms. Divisor positivity holds for every m. Individual coefficients can be negative.
Jordan factorization valid for every real s>0: positive prime-power factors and invertible divisor incidence. It is not a physical Gram comparison.
Fractional-part Mellin continuation splits at 1, and the integration of A uses nonnegative Fubini. Endpoints of every finite residual are integrable on 0<s<1.
The bounded evaluator is asserted only for the exterior-linear subspace, with the entire (0,1) contribution retained; s is restricted to (1/2,1).
The negative floor requires the entire c=-q rule, not an arbitrary old approximant plus a negative PSD correction.
The positive floor follows from c1>=0 and unrestricted minimization over eta; restricting the total nonnegative integral to (0,2) is a valid lower bound.
The rational log bound and gap 55199/13436928 prove strict positivity without relying on rounded decimals.
Projected-cone equality explicitly uses arbitrary finite PSD mixtures and unrestricted old refit. It is not claimed for a single square or constrained trace, diagonal or rank.
The two rank-one generators realize both signs without an uncertified matrix decomposition. Their old components cancel in the projection exactly.
The old-orthogonal LCM pairing matrix has zero diagonal; if nonzero, a nonzero two-by-two minor is indefinite. No particular actual-target observation is assumed nonzero.
LCM support is contained in direct product support but is not identified with NS95 divisor completion. No prime above N appears.
The signed refit moment inequality is necessary, not sufficient; its rho threshold is exactly the pure negative floor.
No error floor for the unrestricted optimum, general Selberg-method obstruction, finite-to-cofinal extrapolation, or actual lower-gain theorem follows.
implementation_checks: Exact integer incidence checks extend to 3*N^2, beyond coefficient support.
Exact rational Jordan checks at exponents 1,2,3 use divisor recursion independent of the product formula.
Signed rank-one generator checks compare actual coefficient maps above N, without replacing the physical Gram by a mock.
At s=4/7, grouped, Jordan, and direct reciprocal-LCM sums overlap with positive enclosures.
256/384-bit scalar enclosures overlap. No midpoint solves or finite physical integrals are used.
17 Maxima exact identities pass; the rational floor typo in the first working draft was corrected before publication and independently checked.
Touched Python passes pyright; all functions annotated. Runtime pins unchanged; no new dependency.
what_had_to_change: Replace ordinary convolution by actual LCM squares for pointwise positivity. Permit old refitting to escape the complete-rule floors; that refit makes unrestricted PSD mixtures exactly a signed space.
obstruction: PSD alone supplies no residual numerator sign after unrestricted old refitting. Complete coefficients with either global PSD sign have a genuine fixed error floor.
bound_or_object: The two named complete coefficient objects fail to converge; the refitted class is not excluded. Failure of an automatic sign mechanism, not of the cofinal actual-target estimate.
HTML_review: Source, formulas, version naming and relative links checked. Prior local-browser URL policy block remains; no browser visual inspection claimed. File preview will be requested for the durable HTML report.
